---
title: "check-self-credits.yml"
---

Diff-scoped, warn-only check that flags a formal credit to the group's own work.
The lab's rule (Ezra, 2026-10-16) is that a link to another of our sites is fine,
but we do not formally acknowledge content borrowed from ourselves
the way we acknowledge content adapted from others.
This implements
[gha#1076](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/1076).

The check flags two things on a line a pull request adds:

- **A citation of an own bibliography entry.**
  An entry is own when its `url`, `doi`, `howpublished` or `note`
  contains one of the config's `urls`,
  when its `author` or `editor` contains one of `authors`,
  or when its key is in `keys`.
  A key in `allow-keys` is never flagged:
  the group's published paper or software,
  cited as the original publication or as a tool used.
  Both `[@key]` and a bare `@key` count.
- **A credit phrase beside an own site or name.**
  A credit phrase is "adapted from", "borrowed from", "reproduced from",
  "reprinted from", "with permission from", "courtesy of" or "credit to",
  a `Source:` line (also in bold, emphasis or a list item),
  or a div titled `Source` (or classed `.source`).
  An own site or name is any entry of `urls` or `names`.
  The own site or name must sit in the same sentence as the credit phrase,
  on the same `Source:` line, or anywhere inside the `Source` div.
  A paragraph ends at a blank line, a heading or a list item.
  Front matter, inline code and code fences are skipped.

The check does not flag a link or a mention on its own
("for further reading, see the sds notes"),
a credit to a person outside the group, a citation of an entry that is not own,
a line matching an `allow-patterns` regular expression,
a cross-reference, a code fence or a chunk option.

## The config file

The lists of own works belong to the consumer repository,
in a restricted YAML file of top-level lists (default `.github/own-works.yml`):

```yaml
urls:            # substrings of a URL, DOI or note that mark a bib entry as own
  - morrison-lab.github.io
  - ucd-serg.github.io/lab-manual
names:           # words or phrases that name an own site or work in prose
  - Morrison-Lab/sds
  - UCD-SERG lab manual
authors:         # substrings of a bib author or editor that mark an entry as own
  - Morrison, Ezra
keys: []         # bib keys that are own whatever their fields say
allow-keys: []   # bib keys never flagged (published paper or software)
allow-patterns: []   # regexes; a matching line is never flagged
bib-globs: ['*.bib'] # git pathspecs of the bibliography files
```

With no config file the check skips with a warning.

## Scope

Only findings on a line a pull request adds are reported.
An added line whose exact text was also deleted in the same diff
counts as moved rather than new.
With no `base-ref`, or when the diff cannot be computed,
the check skips with a warning instead of scanning the whole tree.
Set `whole-tree: true` to scan every tracked file in full on purpose.
Every run prints how many lines, files and paragraphs it examined,
and how many bibliography entries are the group's own.

The check warns by default,
because a credit phrase beside an own name is sometimes right.

A credit is reported on the line that names the own work
and on the line that holds the credit phrase,
so a PR that adds either line is checked.
An abbreviation such as "E." or "et al." does not end a sentence.

A repository link such as `github.com/Morrison-Lab/sds` is matched through
`urls`, not `names`, so list the full URL there.
An HTML comment is scanned like prose.

## Inputs

| Input          | Type    | Default                  | Description |
| -------------- | ------- | ------------------------ | ----------- |
| `config`       | string  | `'.github/own-works.yml'` | Path, in the calling repository, of the YAML file that lists the group's own works. |
| `globs`        | string  | `'*.qmd *.md'`           | Space-separated git pathspecs of tracked files to check (recursive by default). |
| `paths-ignore` | string  | `''`                     | Comma- or newline-separated glob patterns (relative paths) to skip. Supports `*`, `?` and recursive `**`. |
| `fail`         | boolean | `false`                  | Fail the workflow when an added line credits the group's own work. The default only annotates. |
| `whole-tree`   | boolean | `false`                  | Scan every tracked file in full instead of only a PR's added lines. |
| `python-version` | string | `'3.x'`                 | Python version to set up. |
| `runs-on` | string | `'ubuntu-latest'` | Runner label for the job. Use a self-hosted label only for a private repository; never for a public one, whose pull requests can run arbitrary code on it ([#1167](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/1167)). |

## Permissions

Only `contents: read` (the default), so no `permissions:` block is needed.

See
[`examples/check-self-credits.yml`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/blob/main/examples/check-self-credits.yml)
